releaseNotes:
Home Remote 1.2.3

- Clarifies secure WSS and unencrypted WS compatibility modes and adds an explicit secure-connection retry.
- Preserves saved pairing, appearance and preferences during connection recovery and updates.
- Adds local redacted connection-attempt timelines, stage evidence, cancellation reasons and sanitized failure details to diagnostics.
- Reports remain on the phone until you choose Copy or Share.

Install over the existing app. Do not uninstall or clear app data to update.
